comparison.objective: Take an ear temperature by seating a covered probe, pressing Measure, holding it steady, then laying it down.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle constrained insertion along a slanted canal, button actuation, and submillimetric pose holding.
comparison.success_condition: Probe seated, measurement completed during a 3 s steady hold, then thermometer safely released; excessive insertion, motion, or dropping fails.
comparison.reason: This tests depth-limited probe insertion and steady holding during sensing. It does not adjust, lock, or dynamically test a mechanical setting.
